title: 出陣チャレンジ
scope: Presentation only: rename the displayed sortie labels and composite the title over the supplied loop in the existing lamp bay.

image.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent title lettering overlay for the narrow lamp display above the reels of a Japanese pachislot game. Generate the exact Japanese text 「出陣チャレンジ」 in one uninterrupted horizontal line. No other text. Polished dramatic pachislot title: thick highly legible beveled silver/chrome faces, layered bright gold and crimson red outlines, dark thin inner shadow for contrast, a restrained magenta outer glow and a few sharp highlights attached to the letters. Forward-slanted powerful typography. Fit all characters completely without clipping, balanced small transparent margins. Very wide composition, approximately 2000 × 520 px, lettering occupies most of the width and height. Truly transparent alpha background, no scenery, no background panel, no checkerboard, no smoke or large flames: this lettering will be composited over a separately supplied fire video in code. Preserve exact spelling 出 陣 チ ャ レ ン ジ, especially small ャ. Only lettering and its closely attached bevels and outlines.

behavior: Show during each sortie BET; continue the loop across unsuccessful games.
At a winning third stop, reveal the existing flashing character lamps; resume title at next BET.
Hide and pause on sortie completion or reset; preserve the NEBULA entry and subsequent character seven-aim presentations.
Normalize legacy engine/save labels only at the UI boundary. No changes to draw probabilities, RNG consumption, payout or stock.
